units.title: Dome reopening
units.text: After a high-wind alarm, the dome remains closed until the night supervisor authorizes reopening. The authorization is recorded in the observing log before motors are enabled.

units.title: Detector frame preservation
units.text: Immediately after acquisition, raw detector frames are copied to the Glacier vault. A checksum is verified before the local acquisition copy may be removed.

units.title: Calibration lamp records
units.text: Calibration lamp logs are retained for 45 days. Older lamp logs are deleted automatically after the nightly integrity check.

units.title: Weather telemetry source
units.text: The live weather telemetry used by the scheduler comes from mast W3. A separate roof sensor is used only for maintenance diagnostics.

units.title: Focus review
units.text: The instrument scientist reviews focus drift at the start of each observing block and records anomalies in the instrument journal.
